patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high contrast backgrounds (white and dark grey/black) create distinct visual breaks and content blocks.
Hero and major section headings feature extremely large, bold sans-serif typography, often with a split color effect (e.g., 'Field-Proven' in light grey, 'Solutions.' in black).
Subtle, uppercase monospace font is used for metadata, navigation links, and minor labels, providing a technical and precise counterpoint to the display headings.
The primary palette is monochromatic (black, white, various greys) with a very subtle, almost unnoticeable blue accent for interactive elements, maintaining a serious and sophisticated tone.
The hero section features a large text overlay that appears to stick or parallax slightly over a dark video background as the user scrolls, before the background fully recedes.
Content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The site uses a 'hero-video-with-text-overlay' pattern, where a dynamic background video plays behind prominent, oversized text, setting an immediate immersive tone.

technique_notes: To achieve the hero effect, a full-bleed video element is positioned behind a large, fixed-position text element. As the user scrolls, the video background scrolls away at a normal rate, while the text element either remains fixed or scrolls at a slower, parallax-like rate, creating depth.

Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations. As a section's top edge enters the viewport, it transitions from an initial hidden state (e.g., slightly transparent and offset downwards) to its final visible state (fully opaque and in position), creating a smooth reveal effect.
The navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the entire scroll, providing persistent access to site sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) with a mix of weights and colors, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, monospace labels and standard sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between sections and ample internal padding within content blocks, creating a clean and uncrowded feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, oversized typography in the hero and section headings, often using a split-color effect to emphasize key words. This, combined with the subtle video background and scroll-triggered reveals, creates a sophisticated and almost editorial aesthetic that feels both modern and authoritative.
